title: Input tape position encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $w$ be a finite Boolean input string, and let $t,p$ be nonnegative integers. The input position encoding at $p$ consists of the Boolean indicator that the input head is at position $p$, followed by the Boolean encoding of the input chain value at $p$.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
